targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM reporting.sm_monitors m WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer)))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS impaired FROM reporting.sm_monitors m WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer))) AND (SELECT mox.serviceHealth FROM reporting.sm_monitoroutages mox WHERE mox.monOutageID=(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mo2.serviceHealth!=10 THEN mo2.monOutageID END), MAX(mo2.monOutageID)) FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm2 JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo2 ON mm2.monOutageID=mo2.monOutageID WHERE mm2.monitorMH=m.monitorMH)) IN ($downStates)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo()))),4) AS avail FROM reporting.sm_monitors m LEFT JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer)))

SELECT m.monName AS `Service`, ROUND(o.down_secs/3600,3) AS `Downtime (h)` FROM reporting.sm_monitors m JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND o.down_secs>0 AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer))) ORDER BY `Downtime (h)` DESC LIMIT $topN

SELECT m.monName AS `Service`, m.monitorMH AS `monitorMH`, m.monCriticality AS `Criticality`, COALESCE(sh.serviceHealthName,'Up') AS `Current Health`, COALESCE(o.outages,0) AS `Outages`, CONCAT(FLOOR(COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/86400),' Days ',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(COALESCE(o.down_secs,0),86400)/3600),2,'0'),':',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(COALESCE(o.down_secs,0),3600)/60),2,'0'),':',LPAD(MOD(COALESCE(o.down_secs,0),60),2,'0')) AS `Total Downtime`, ROUND(100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo())),4) AS `Availability %` FROM reporting.sm_monitors m LEFT JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, COUNT(DISTINCT mo.monOutageID) AS outages, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH LEFT JOIN reporting.sm_servicehealth sh ON sh.serviceHealth=(SELECT mox.serviceHealth FROM reporting.sm_monitoroutages mox WHERE mox.monOutageID=(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mo3.serviceHealth!=10 THEN mo3.monOutageID END), MAX(mo3.monOutageID)) FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm3 JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo3 ON mm3.monOutageID=mo3.monOutageID WHERE mm3.monitorMH=m.monitorMH)) WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer))) ORDER BY `Availability %` ASC

SELECT m.monName AS `Service`, r.resourceName AS `Resource`, r.resourceTypeName AS `Type`, r.resourceModelClass AS `Class` FROM reporting.sm_monitors m JOIN reporting.sm_slmmonitors smm ON m.monitorMH=smm.monitorMH AND smm.monitorsDestroyTime IS NULL JOIN reporting.sm_resources r ON smm.resourceMH=r.resourceMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) AND (-1 IN ($customer) OR m.monitorMH IN (SELECT su.monitorMH FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND su.customerMH IN ($customer))) ORDER BY m.monName, r.resourceName

targets.rawSql: SELECT cust.custName AS `Customer`, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(cust.primContLocation,''), NULLIF(cust.secContLocation,'')), ',', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,6)) AS `Latitude`, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(cust.primContLocation,''), NULLIF(cust.secContLocation,'')), ',', -1)) AS DECIMAL(10,6)) AS `Longitude`, MAX(svc.sev_rank) AS `Health`, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(svc.monName, ': ', svc.healthName) ORDER BY svc.sev_rank DESC, svc.monName SEPARATOR ' | ') AS `Services (worst to best)` FROM reporting.sm_customers cust JOIN reporting.sm_customermhs cm ON cm.custName=cust.custName AND cm.customerMH NOT IN (0,1) JOIN ( SELECT su.customerMH, m.monName, COALESCE(sh.serviceHealthName,'Up') AS healthName, CASE COALESCE(sh.serviceHealthName,'Up') WHEN 'Up' THEN 0 WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 1 WHEN 'Slightly Degraded' THEN 2 WHEN 'Degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'Down' THEN 4 WHEN 'Loss Of Management' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS sev_rank FROM reporting.sm_slmuses su JOIN reporting.sm_monitors m ON m.monitorMH=su.monitorMH AND m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) LEFT JOIN reporting.sm_servicehealth sh ON sh.serviceHealth=(SELECT mox.serviceHealth FROM reporting.sm_monitoroutages mox WHERE mox.monOutageID=(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mo3.serviceHealth!=10 THEN mo3.monOutageID END), MAX(mo3.monOutageID)) FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm3 JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo3 ON mm3.monOutageID=mo3.monOutageID WHERE mm3.monitorMH=m.monitorMH)) WHERE su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($service) OR m.monitorMH IN ($service)) ) svc ON svc.customerMH=cm.customerMH WHERE (-1 IN ($customer) OR cm.customerMH IN ($customer)) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(cust.primContLocation,''), NULLIF(cust.secContLocation,'')) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust.custName, cust.primContLocation, cust.secContLocation
